history.sg_progress: Mutual recognition was handed over to the High-Level Committee on Management, which will work on any subsequent work related to it. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the mutual recognition principle is expeditiously signed off by the remaining entities.
history.administration_response: Based on the documents provided by the Development Coordination Office, including the latest Organization signatures for 2021, the Administration intends to call a meeting between the Board’s volume I audit team and the Office, the Department of Operational Support and the Business Transformation and Accountability Division to further discuss why this recommendation should be closed. Additional documentation will be provided.
history.board_assessment: Given that the mutual recognition principle is very important, that 94 per cent of United Nations Sustainable Development Group entities had signed it in 2021, that consistent efforts are in process and that the High-level Committee on Management needs to take further action to ensure that the mutual recognition principle is signed by the remaining entities, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
